description: The edge spec leaves `token` on the token response as a plain string and `kubeconfig` on the kubeconfig response as an open map, but both hold a live credential for the instance's Kubernetes API (spec: getTokenByInstanceId 'Returns an ServiceAccount token'). STACKIT's own Terraform provider marks both `Sensitive: true` (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/edgecloud/kubeconfig/resource.go and token/resource.go, read 2026-11-01). A sensitive trait on a map member wraps nothing, because the wrapper only takes strings and untyped values, so the kubeconfig member is retargeted to `smithy.api#Document`: the whole object decodes to one Redacted value. The wire doesn't change. No live probe.
